status: frozen before any Phase XI deep value (Y5, Y6, Lambda_R for R > 15, D_8 of new rules) was computed

L_ref.meaning: rational lower bound on E_*(1387) <= the R = 15 certificate 8.7999987799...; used only if the independent R = 15 re-certification (phase11_chair) passes; otherwise the R = 14 value 8.7644994 is used and every comparison is redone

part_II_elimination_rule: r is proven inferior to 1387 iff an exact rational upper bound U(r) (Rayleigh quotient on a pinned legal supertile or ball) satisfies U(r) < L_ref; nothing else eliminates. Proper classes: U = min(exact Y4, Y5, Y6, D_R) from Phase X artifacts and Phase XI recomputation. Extended space: stages X3 -> X4 -> X5 on all 280332 S3-orbit representatives, each stage evaluated on the survivors of the previous one.

part_II_classification.unresolved: overlap and no available method decides at feasible cost

part_II_targets.escalation: R + 2 up to R = 20 if any ball fails; every attempt recorded
R + 1 up to R = 22; a failure is reported with the failing balls float values

part_II_twin_criterion.pairs: the 40 proper classes with the largest Y4 (census) and their mirror twins (every child frame right-multiplied by S = (x y))
part_II_twin_criterion.predictor: sign(U1(twin) - U1(r)), U1 = min over Phi-closed legal 1-star types of lambda_min(pinned sigma(tau))
part_II_twin_criterion.outcome: sign(Y5(twin) - Y5(r)) (finite-level proxy; float eigenvalues, residual reported); secondary: sign of Y4 difference
part_II_twin_criterion.report: accuracy with exact binomial 95% interval; no threshold tuning

part_V_counterfactuals.neighbour_set: every extended decoration differing from the base in exactly one child frame (all 6 permutations allowed), one per S3 orbit
part_V_counterfactuals.deep_outcome: Y5 (exact rational upper bound and float)

predictions.P1: Spearman rho(U1, Y5) over each neighbour set >= 0.8
predictions.P2: sign(Y5(nb) - Y5(base)) = sign(U1(nb) - U1(base)) for at least 80% of neighbours
predictions.P3: the neighbour with the largest Y5 is among the 3 neighbours with the largest U1
predictions.P4: mechanism of FR30 -> 4753: the U1-minimising environment type of FR30 is NOT legal for 4753 (removal), rather than present with a raised energy

part_V_counterfactuals.interpretation: P1-P3 test correlation/selection only; a sufficient criterion is a certified bound (Lambda_R); no necessary-and-sufficient characterisation is claimed
